# MQ Adorn

MQ Adorn is an online shop for jewellery and dresses, delivered across Pakistan. The collection is jewellery-first (earrings, necklaces, rings, bracelets, bangles and jewellery sets) and also includes dresses.

Website: https://mqadorn.vercel.app
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/mqadorn.pk/
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@mqadorn.pk

## Buying

- Guest checkout is available; creating an account is optional.
- Payment is by JazzCash, Easypaisa or bank transfer only. A payment screenshot must be uploaded with the order.
- MQ Adorn does not offer Cash on Delivery and does not take card payments on the website.
- After payment is confirmed, delivery details are shared on WhatsApp. MQ Adorn delivers across Pakistan.
- Shipping is free on orders above Rs. 5,000. Orders under that amount have a flat shipping fee of Rs. 250. These amounts are set in the shop and may be updated by the owner.
- All sales are final. MQ Adorn does not accept returns, refunds or exchanges, and an order cannot be cancelled for a refund after it has been placed and paid.
